SELECT p.user_id, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, p.employee_type FROM hrp_user_profile p JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE -- 1. 必须是同一家店的在职员工 p.main_store_id = #{storeId} AND p.status = '0' -- 2. 不能是正在被代班的原始员工 AND p.user_id != #{originalUserId} -- 3. 必须拥有指定的技能 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hrp_user_skills us WHERE us.user_id = p.user_id AND us.skill_id = #{skillId} ) -- 4. 在指定日期没有其他排班 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hrp_schedules s WHERE s.user_id = p.user_id AND s.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} ) -- 5. (可选但推荐) 在指定日期没有请假 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hrp_leave_applications la WHERE la.user_id = p.user_id AND #{scheduleDate} BETWEEN DATE(la.start_time) AND DATE(la.end_time) AND la.approval_status = '已批准' )
